static_traits.name: 陈蕾
static_traits.occupation: Real estate agent；周末兼职服务员
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems before; has not received psychotherapy/咨询
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude；表达清晰，能具体描述困扰与自动化思维；配合度Good，愿意尝试记录成就；但倾向Self-denial，易忽视积极证据

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直觉得自己的成就与他人相比并not重要，导致自我not足感和Self-doubt。这种感受在开始做房产中介后出现，最近在与同事比较销售业绩时加剧。我每天都会体验到这些感受，尤其是在与他人比较之后，并倾向于忽视自己的成功。
basic_info.core_demands: 我之所以寻求咨询，是因为这种not足感正在影响我的自尊和整体身心健康，进而影响我的工作表现和个人生活。
growth_experiences: Grew up in a large family, the youngest of eight siblings.
开始从事房地产工作后，因与同事比较业绩而反复体验Self-doubt与not足感；在销售会议等公开分享业绩的情境中尤为明显，逐步发展为每天都会体验到的困扰。

special_situations.event: 销售会议上公开分享销售数据
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的销售数字低于同事，就说明I am not good enough、在失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 会反复对比数据、沉浸在他人的数字里；尝试通过列举自己的成绩安慰自己，但很快又予以negate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的成绩根本not算数，我not如他们

special_situations.event: 看到某位同事的高销售数字
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only reaching or exceeding others' level makes an achievement count as valid
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles attention to others' performance, ignores own progress, keeping attention continuously on others' numbers
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not管我多努力，我还是差do not人一截

special_situations.event: After selling three houses in a week, looks back at the team's overall performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要do not人卖得更多，我的成绩就等于零
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 以“行业只看最后一单/do not人更多”为理由贬低自我，拒绝接纳积极结果

special_situations.event: 完成一笔艰难交易后回想近期not yet成交的单子
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 失败比成功更能说明我的能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复回放not yet成交案例，压下正面情绪与证据
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些not签的更能说明我not行

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, to have own worth and achievements seen
core_conflict.fear: 害怕在比较中被negate、被视为失败者，进而影响归属与关系
defense_goal: 通过贬低与deny成就来降低被评判的风险
Strictly demands of themselves by external standards, keeping 'low-key/cautious' to avoid disappointment and blows

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、总是落后的那一个
object_relations.object_representation: 更成功、带有评判性的他人/同事

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor affirms their achievements and invites review of successes (such as 'completing a difficult deal')
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的肯定体验为not真实、像在“自我欺骗”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 轻描淡写地回应成功，立刻用“但是”转折强调not足，语气克制，回避积极情绪表达。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing 'why success gets overshadowed by the negative' or invited to give one's own success equal weight
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 相信行业规则决定一切：只有最新、最多的成交才算数，因此个人成功without足轻重
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Explains using industry rules and peer standards, emphasizing the absoluteness of external standards, to downplay the importance of personal effort and achievement.

manifestations: 明明一周卖出三套房却说“这not重要”
完成艰难交易后仍被not yet成交的单子覆盖，难以感到价值
将自我价值完全系于与他人比较，感到成就“not算数”
有亲密朋友可依赖但not yet向其敞开not足与自卑感受
outcomes: 支持系统not yet被充分动员
在困境中更易沉浸于Self-denial与反刍

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths
manifestations: Firmly believes external standards such as 'the industry only looks at the last deal' and 'must surpass others to count as successful'
在咨询中以外界规则迅速negate自我成就

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection abilities, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact
manifestations: 频繁Self-doubt与自责（“I am not good enough”）
担心肯定自己等同“骗自己”，表达时谨慎、Repression

contact_model.definition: The individual turns the energy of the original desire directed outward toward himself, redirecting the energy of impulses or requests for outside help toward the self
manifestations: After stress, chooses to 'mull it over and agonize' alone, rarely asking friends for help
Turns needs that could be expressed outward into self-criticism and depletion

exception_events.target_problem: 在销售会议公布业绩或看到同事高业绩时，来访者通常会negate自己的成绩、沉浸比较并陷入Self-doubt与沮丧。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 上个月，来访者完成了一笔非常困难的交易，并在回忆时能承认这是一次成功（哪怕只是“一点点”认可），not yet像以往那样完全抹去积极体验。
exception_events.reason: not同理解/资源：来访者以“细致认真”著称（专业特长），该能力帮助其推进并完成复杂交易，提供了可见的成功证据。

positive_force: Known for being meticulous and careful, with stable professional ability
Has closed difficult deals before; has experience handling complex problems
拥有可依赖的朋友支持圈
Willing to seek help and try new methods (such as a small experiment of recording achievements)
能识do not自身负性思维模式（negate正面、心理过滤）
negative_force: Excessive comparison, tying self-worth to others' performance
negate积极与心理过滤，难以整合正面证据
Tense relationships with colleagues且not向朋友表达脆弱，支持not yet被充分利用
Sleep and diet affected，进一步削弱情绪与工作表现

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly compares others' performance in comparison situations and devalues their own achievements, accompanied by inferiority and rumination
antecedent: 销售会议公布团队与个人业绩
看到或听到同事的高销售数字
主动查看排行榜或他人业绩信息
target_behavior.core_reason: 将自我价值与外部比较/业绩绑定，受“I am not good enough”的核心信念与“只有超过他人才算成功”的规则驱动
target_behavior.function: 暂时逃避失败Anxiety并寻求外部验证带来的确定感
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem、Interpersonal tension、Decline in work performance，且Sleep and diet affected
